How to Build a Document Portal for Massage Therapists with Base44

As a massage therapist, you understand the importance of keeping accurate and up-to-date records of your clients' treatment plans, consent forms, and payment information. A document portal can help you streamline your workflow, reduce administrative tasks, and improve client satisfaction. In this article, we'll explore how to build a document portal for massage therapists using Base44, the AI-powered no-code app builder.

What is a Document Portal?

A document portal is a centralized online platform where you can store, manage, and share documents with your clients. It's a secure and convenient way to keep all your client-related documents in one place, making it easier to access and update them as needed. With a document portal, you can:

  • Store client intake forms, treatment plans, and consent forms
  • Manage client payment information and invoices
  • Share documents with clients and colleagues securely
  • Track client interactions and communication

By using a document portal, you can reduce paperwork, minimize errors, and improve client engagement. And with Base44, you can build a custom document portal without any coding experience.
